generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All other terms and conditions are as per the bid document attached

technicalCriterionList.description: TECHNICAL QUALIFYING CRITERIA: i. The Bidder must have designed, engineered, manufactured/ get manufactured, supplied, erected, commissioned at least one Project of Waste to Energy plant of minimum 5MW and above capacity with municipal solid waste/ RDF based on Grate Combustion system (Incineration technology) anywhere in the world. The same shall be in successful operation for a period of not less than Two (02) years in the preceding Five years at the time of bid submission. OR

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- RELEVANT DOCUMENTS SHALL BE FURNISHED

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have designed, engineered, supplied, erected/ supervised erection, commissioned/ supervised commissioning of atleast one Grate, Heat recovery system and Flue gas treatment system for any waste to energy plant of minimum 5MW and above capacity with municipal solid waste/RDF, anywhere in the world, and the Waste to Energy plant should have been successfully commissioned (with or without consortium). The same shall be in successful operation for a period of not less than Two (02) years in the preceding Five years at the time of bid submission. OR

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- RELEVANT DOCUMENTS SHALL BE FURNISHED

technicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have developed at least one Project of waste to energy of minimum 5MW and above capacity with municipal solid waste/ RDF based on Grate Combustion system (Incineration technology) anywhere in the world and the same shall be in successful operation for a period of not less than Two (02) years in the preceding Five years at the time of bid submission. The Bidder or Consortium bidder must have designed, engineered, manufactured, supplied, erected, commissioned at least one Project of waste to energy of minimum 5MW and above with municipal solid waste/ RDF anywhere in the world, and same shall be up and running for a period of not less than Two (02) years at the time of bid submission. Bidder should have undertaken Projects in MSW for Government/ Municipalities or other similar authorities.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- RELEVANT DOCUMENTS SHALL BE FURNISHED

technicalCriterionList.description: ii. In case of consortium, the Bidder shall furnish Consortium Agreement executed with collaborator along with Techno- commercial Bid. In which the executants of Consortium shall be jointly and severally liable to the corporation for successful performance of contract.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- RELEVANT DOCUMENTS SHALL BE FURNISHED

technicalCriterionList.description: FINANCIAL QUALIFYING CRITERIA: i. Annual turnover of the bidder shall not be less than INR 411.75 Crore in any two of the preceding five financial years. The single entity or any one member of the consortium or all the consortium partner combinedly meet the financial criteria.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- RELEVANT DOCUMENTS SHALL BE FURNISHED

technicalCriterionList.description: ii. For financial qualifying requirement, Copies of audited P&L Account/ annual report/ audited balance sheet duly certified by the Chartered Accountant to establish annual turnover requirement stipulated above shall be submitted.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- RELEVANT DOCUMENTS SHALL BE FURNISHED

technicalCriterionList.description: iii. Bidder qualifying the technical criteria and not fulfilling the financial criteria, such bidder can claim their parent companys financial strength to meet the financial criteria. However, bidder cannot claim the parent company technical qualification for submitting this bid. Also, such bidder shall submit the financial documents of parent company along with Bidders financial documents. The intending bidder shall fulfill all the qualifying requirements as indicated in 2.0(a) to (b) above.
